summary: Sample list of ansible_facts['os_family'] values (AIX, Darwin, Debian, FreeBSD, RedHat, Solaris, Suse, Windows and more); if no mapping matches, platform.system() is returned.
questions: What happens if Ansible doesn't recognize the OS family?

answer_card.title: Possible ansible_facts['os_family'] values
answer_card.answer_md:
Sample values: AIX, Alpine, Altlinux, Archlinux, Darwin, Debian, FreeBSD, Gentoo, HP-UX, Mandrake, RedHat, SMGL, Slackware, Solaris, Suse, Windows.

Ansible checks `OS_FAMILY_MAP`; if nothing matches it returns `platform.system()`.
